issue_context.title: bottleneck when accessing rowContainer.m.Mutex in HashJoinExec
issue_context.body: ## Enhancement ### Workload [1W.txt](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/files/7044518/1W.txt) [150W.txt](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/files/7044519/150W.txt) ``` sql drop table if exists t1, t2, t3; create table t1(c1 int); create table t2(c1 int); create table t3(c1 int); load data local infile '$dir$/150W.sql' into table t1 fields terminated by ' '; load data local infile '$dir$/1W.sql' into table t2 fields terminated by ' '; load data local infile '$dir$/1W.sql' into table t3 fields terminated by ' '; ``` ### Test SQL ``` sql set @@tidb_executor_concurrency=$N$; select /*+ hash_join(t1, t2) */ * from t1 inner join t2 inner join t3 on t1.c1 = t2.c1 and t2.c1 = t3.c1 limit 1 offset 153599999; ``` ### Test Result |tidb_executor_concurrency|latency| |--|--| |2|25.78s| |4|17.14s| |8|17.30s| |16|17.76s| |32|17.38s| ### Analysis The test result shows that the query performance does not improve as the concurrency increase. After the profile, we can see that there is a bottleneck when invoking `rowContainer.GetRow`. ### Summary We can refine the usage of Mutex in RowContainer to eliminate the bottleneck.
